item.title: TTT 362: Rolling Thunder
item.description:
Chris Austman of AM Static joins us at Tip Tap Tip HQ to talk music, racism, and getting partying all day, every day. Eric is working on his time machine that only goes to 1986. Rachelle keeps it real. Eric might be secretly racist. He also mispronounces the name of Chris’ bandmate in AM Static because he’s a fucking jerk (Eric, not Nils).

Guest: Chris Austman

  • AM Static - Sept 14, 2013 - Picnic 2013
  • AM Static - Sept 22, 2013 - Calgary AIDS Walk
